content.value: Choose λ that makes the following system of equations consistent and find the general solution(13) of the system for that λ.

$$
x + y - z + t = 2 , \qquad 2 y + 4 z + 2 t = 3 , \qquad x + 2 y + z + 2 t = \lambda .
$$
